description: Glossary of known PDF/OCR conversion artifacts in SRD_CC_v5.2.1.md and their canonical repairs. Applied in order by scripts/repair_source.py; each entry is a documented, reviewable substitution. Add new artifact classes here, never as ad-hoc code.

substitutions.meaning: Dice expressions: OCR reads the digit 1 as capital I, e.g. 'Id6' means '1d6', 'Id10' means '1d10'.
Enhancement bonuses: '+I Longsword' means '+1 Longsword' (Magic Item Categories examples).
Flat weapon damage: the Blowgun deals '1 Piercing', OCR-read as 'I Piercing'.
Heading: the d20 rule section is 'Rolling 20 or 1'.
Stat-block layout: the CR line was joined onto the Languages line during conversion; they are separate lines in the printed SRD.
CR parenthetical: canonical SRD ordering is 'CR n (XP n; PB +n)'; a few blocks print 'n XP'.
Class feature levels: 'Level II' is OCR for 'Level 11' (e.g. 'Level 11: Relentless Rage').
Class feature levels: 'Level I' is OCR for 'Level 1' (headings, 'As a Level 1 Character', spell-slot table captions). Applied after level-II-to-11.
Hit Point Die notation: 'DI0' is OCR for 'D10' (Fighter and Ranger core traits).

ability_table_glossary.meaning: Inside monster ability-score tables only: standalone 'I' means 1, 'II' means 11; labels may be LaTeX-wrapped ('$\mathbf{S_{TR}}$' means STR) or glued to the score ('CON25' means CON 25). Any historical table reconstruction was cross-checked against the official SRD PDF text layer; no external dataset contributes retained values.
